name: overlay-routing-divider-grab-sync
description: The page prepares a layout with no surface whose plane holds one divider and then draws it, and the sync request of the preparation carries the grab area of the divider in page coordinates as its overlay; the host answers with its ticket, no placement and the window chrome, the drawn commit measures the same grab area and sends no second sync request, and the page presents the ticket and the host answers with no placement.
reason: syncSurfaces and presentSurfaces place native surfaces in a window, and only the native host with a window produces their answers (the native tier of docs/operations/examples.md#test-kinds).
